trendMeta.combinedB30Rule: merge both servers by chart/difficulty, keep higher score, include all charts including N20 candidates, calculate with MATE constants, truncate each chart rating to 2 decimals, then average top 30
trendMeta.rinFallback: playlog playerRating first; X-VERSE-X B30+N20 reconstruction when missing
trendMeta.trackRating: MATE constant + merged winning score; chart rating truncated to 2 decimals during sync

notes.trackIndex: Same chart keeps the higher score between national cabinet and RIN; Rating is recalculated from inferred chart constant when available.
notes.ability: RIN real playlog, player rating >= 16.00, lower quartile (P25).
notes.monthly: National cabinet monthly counts are literal CSV rows with a valid play_time; no 3-song/4-song PC inference. Undated rows are excluded from monthly buckets. RIN uses actual playlog rows.
notes.trend: Three lines share one chart. Historical values are reconstructed from available score history; the latest 16.72 / 16.84 / 17.049 snapshot is exact.
